Hi David,
 You asked for a full refund on January 1. You are getting it — $51.89, refunded in full , back to the payment method you used. There is nothing you need to do.
 I am not going to dress up what happened. You ordered on November 28. Nothing left our warehouse until March 24 — nearly four months, and three months after you had already asked to be refunded. You wrote twice and got no answer either time. That is indefensible, and I am sorry.
 If the seed bombs do eventually turn up at your door, keep them. You have earned them.
 Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
